title: AItonomy/ScienceIDE-Traces
description:
sciaccel-rl agent traces
	

Harbor trial traces for the sciaccel-rl task bank: one folder per trial
under traces/<job>/<trial>/, containing result.json (timings, tokens and
cost), reward.json, and agent/ (ATIF trajectory.json plus native session
logs). Per-task eval records linking to these traces live under
envs/<environment>/tasks/<category>/<tier>/<task>/eval/ in the source repo.
skip_reason: gated, private or disabled: files need an account
